jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The groom keeps his proud smile, chest out. The daughter says it proudly, pointing at the groom with her free hand. The father's eyes light up, he leans forward with a greedy smile and says his line, his face clearly visible.
chute: The groom's proud smile melts and he swallows hard. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the generous groom's panicked face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE FIANCÉ EN APPRENANT À COMPTER :
mecanisme: expression prise au pied de la lettre (dépenser sans compter → il ne sait pas compter, donc on gonfle la dot)
